messages:
maria: incident-bot paged us: high 503 rate on /v1/generate, spike started ~2814999980, affecting a subset of customers (BrightApps prod, AcmeCorp staging).
incident-bot: [ALERT] routing-compile-backlog -> 503 threshold exceeded. Pager: alex.
alex: oncall here, joining bridge in 2.
jordan: I'll pull the compile-worker logs and autoscaler metrics.
alex: initial look: compile queue backlog causing request timeouts; autoscaler reacting and marking pods unhealthy -> traffic routing failing. starting manual restarts of compile workers.
maria: CS heads up: customers impacted as listed. Sophie, can you start a customer note draft?
sophie: on it. Need a 2–3 line summary + what we did to mitigate + when we'll send RCA.
alex: short summary for draft: routing compile queue regression created backlog; compile workers hit an OOM loop causing healthchecks to fail; autoscaler removed capacity and routing fallback didn't trigger due to threshold bug. Mitigations applied: 1) restarted compile workers 2) forced fallback route to variant B 3) hotfix PR to routing fallback thresholds.
jordan: PR #5423 opened to relax fallback threshold and add a secondary check for compile backlog. Pushing now.
incident-bot: deploy PR #5423 succeeded in us-west-2.
alex: 503s dropped to baseline (<0.1%). Traffic normalizing.
sophie: draft status page blurb: 
```
Summary: Brief service disruption impacting generation endpoints due to a routing compile backlog that caused elevated 503 errors for some customers.
Impact: Increased error rate and elevated latency for up to ~14 minutes for a subset of requests.
Mitigation: Restarted compile workers, applied routing fallback hotfix, and rolled a deploy to restore healthy routing.
Next steps: Full RCA and list of preventative actions to be shared within 24 hours.
```
maria: BrightApps asked for timeline and compensation. Recommend offering 5% service credit for impacted window and RCA by EOD tomorrow. Thoughts?
cs-lead: 5% credit OK. Also propose 72-hour remediation plan and a postmortem meeting invite.
sophie: I'll send the customer note now. Proposed customer message: 
"Hi BrightApps — we experienced a short disruption affecting generation requests. Root cause: compile backlog in routing service leading to failover not engaging. Mitigation: hotfix and worker restarts. We will send a full RCA by <tomorrow EOD> and apply a 5% service credit for affected usage. If you need immediate escalation, reply here or contact support@redwood.ai."

maria: include status page link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2815000000 and the contact point.
sophie: sent to BrightApps, cc @cs-lead.
alex: internal RCA notes: timeline added to the draft — compile queue grew at 2814999940, first 503 at 2814999990, autoscaler removed nodes at 2815000005, hotfix deployed 2815000120, full recovery 2815000145. Posting draft to #eng-runtime for review.
jordan: added logs + timeline to drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/incident-2815. Also added metric charts.
sophie: follow-up checklist for customer closure: ["Publish full RCA", "Confirm service credit applied", "Schedule 1:1 with BrightApps if requested", "Share remediation roadmap"].
cs-lead: create Jira RED-1199, owner alex, due 72h.
alex: will author RCA and remediation tasks, ping @jordan for final logs.
maria: thanks all. I'll update the customer-success board and mark incident as closed for paging; we'll reconvene after RCA review. :thumbsup:
